text: haha yes bitcchch i got it [Image #20] it was just edges and face [Image #21] thanks
resolution: User confirmed success — the cab front closed cleanly using edge selection + Create face, completing the enclose-the-interior task end to end (solid walls via the new solidify button, plus Create-face firewall, floor, and back wall). Celebratory close-out, no code change this turn. Recapped the two-tool model for future reference: Create face to close any opening (flat, never buckles) and solidify to thicken see-into shells (avoiding thin/tight faces, the one buckle they hit and undid). Noted the solidify toolbar button shipped earlier this session (sha f35f2d448, req_1230) is the only persistent code artifact; reiterated the standing offer to add a thin-part guard to solidify if desired.
